Brice Sensabaugh just made NBA HISTORY! At 23 years and 18 days old, Sensabaugh becomes the youngest player ever to record 40+ points, 10+ rebounds and 8+ three-pointers in a game—and the first player in Jazz franchise history to reach those marks!
He also becomes Utah’s first player to finish a game with 40+ points, 10+ rebounds, 5+ assists and 5+ made threes. Watch the highlights from his historic all-around performance!
